title: 第9660章 支柱级第9659章 蝼蚁
content_zh:
从陈雄出手，到横飞出去，砸到地面，整个过程不过三息都不到。
战斗可以说一瞬间就结束了。
这片天地，庄园里面，在此时化作了彻底的死寂!
正厅内的灵墨轩目瞪口呆，嘴巴张得老大!
王明阳也是瞠目结舌!
外面。
冉少燕美眸圆瞪，心中掀起了惊涛骇浪，但随之而来的是无边的激动与惊喜!
而冉伟……
他同样满脸的震撼与不可思议，如果原本他看向叶无缺的目光是带着礼貌和探究的话，那么现在就已经化为了彻底的敬畏!!
正厅前。
叶无缺缓缓收回了手。
他面色平静，没有露出任何喜悦或者志得意满的意思。
因为他早就已经知道了这个结果。
毕竟，在他去往圣人王试炼前，还是七步时，综合战力就已经快要玄神无敌了!
更何况现在。
玄神大圆满?
一巴掌而已。
“爹!爹!叶阁下他、他……陈雄，陈雄可以玄神大圆满!是阵营内的玄神大圆满啊!!”冉少燕瞬间回过神来，心绪澎湃到难以置信!
冉伟的身影也已经落到了地面，与冉少燕站在了一起，但目光自始至终都盯着叶无缺。
“他不是玄神大圆满，他是……支柱级!”

“放在阵营之中，叶阁下所表现出来的实力那是赤裸裸的支柱级啊!!”
冉伟的声音都带着一丝颤抖。
支柱级!
从自己父亲口中听到了这三个字眼的瞬间，冉少燕直接心神轰鸣，浑身都是震动!
“爹，你确定??”
“要知道，在阵营之中，如果玄神大圆满代表着意义非凡，是每一个派系的高层，那么支柱级，可就是每一个派系真正的话事人，代表着最高权力与武力啊!”
冉少燕忍不住复述了一遍“支柱级”的意义与含金量。
“不会错的，女儿，这一点我怎么会看错?”
“陈雄这家伙的玄神大圆满虽然有点水分，在玄神大圆满中只能算是中规中矩，但被一巴掌就扇飞了出去，这是压倒性的碾压!”
“在玄神这个领域，这就代表了……玄神无敌!”
“凌驾于玄神大圆满之上，所以才能成为阵营每一个派系真正的支柱!”
“支柱，支柱!”
“如果没有绝对强大的武力与暴力，如何有资格称得上支柱级?”
“女儿，这一次，你立大功了!”
“能够有机会认识叶阁下这样的存在，并且尝试结交，若能成功，收获难以想象!”
冉伟的传音语气都激动了起来，难以自已。
很显然，他一路跟着冉少燕离开了阵营，除了南部区域没去外，当冉少燕带着叶无缺返回中央帝域后，冉伟就已经暗中跟了上来。
所以，对于叶无缺一路上的情况，冉伟并非两眼一抹黑，而是知道一些。
“爹!”
“山河秘境册!”

“叶阁下需要山河秘境册，本来我答应叶阁下来这里就是因为七叔手里有，结果发生了这样的事情。”
“叶阁下对于特殊的天地环境很喜欢，想要找到满足他需求的天地环境，那种阴阳失衡或者崩塌类的，山河秘境册上或许有记载，你带了吗?”
冉少燕快速的立刻告诉给冉伟这些情况。
“山河秘境册?这……我没带!但老七身上的确有，他是隐秘驻地负责人。”
“该死，老七还被那邱嬷嬷应该拦住了，必须我亲自走一趟!”
content_en:
From the moment Chen Xiong took action to flying out and hitting the ground, the whole process took less than three breaths.
The battle could be said to be over in an instant.
This world, inside the manor, turned into complete silence at this time!
Lingmo Xuan in the main hall was stunned and his mouth opened wide!
Wang Mingyang was also stunned!
outside.
Ran Shaoyan's beautiful eyes widened, and her heart was filled with turmoil, but what followed was boundless excitement and surprise!
And Ran Wei...
His face was also full of shock and disbelief. If his gaze towards Ye Wuque was originally polite and inquisitive, it has now turned into complete awe!!
In front of the main hall.
Ye Wuque slowly retracted his hand.
His face was calm, showing no sign of joy or complacency.
Because he already knew the result.
After all, before he went to the Sage King trial, when he was still seven steps away, his overall combat power was already close to that of Xuan Shen Invincible!
Even more so now.
Xuan Shen Dzogchen?
Just a slap.
"Dad! Dad! Mr. Ye, he, he... Chen Xiong, Chen Xiong can achieve the Great Perfection of the Mysterious God! He is the Great Perfection of the Mysterious God in the camp!!" Ran Shaoyan came back to her senses in an instant, feeling so excited that it was unbelievable!
Ran Wei's figure has also fallen to the ground, standing with Ran Shaoyan, but his eyes were fixed on Ye Wuque from beginning to end.
"He is not the Mysterious God of Perfection, he is... a pillar level!"
"Putting it within the camp, the strength displayed by Mr. Ye is a naked pillar level!!"
Ran Wei's voice was trembling.
Pillar level!
The moment she heard these three words from her father's mouth, Ran Shaoyan's heart roared and her whole body was shaken!
"Dad, are you sure??"
"You know, in the camp, if the Mysterious God Perfection represents extraordinary significance and is the top of each faction, then the pillar level is the real talker of each faction, representing the highest power and force!"
Ran Shaoyan couldn't help but repeat the meaning and value of "pillar level".
"You can't be wrong, daughter, how could I get this wrong?"
"Although Chen Xiong's Xuan Shen Dzogchen is a little watery, it can only be regarded as quite satisfactory among Xuan Shen Dzogchen, but he was slapped and flew away. This is an overwhelming crushing!"
"In the field of Xuan Shen, this means...Xuan Shen is invincible!"
"It is above the Great Perfection of the Mysterious God, so it can become the true pillar of every faction in the camp!"
"Pillar, pillar!"
"If you don't have absolutely powerful force and violence, how can you be qualified to be called a pillar level?"
"Daughter, this time, you have made a great contribution!"
"Having the opportunity to get to know someone like Mr. Ye, and trying to make friends with him, if you succeed, the rewards will be unimaginable!"
Ran Wei's tone of voice transmission was so excited that he couldn't help himself.
Obviously, he followed Ran Shaoyan all the way out of the camp. Except for the southern area, when Ran Shaoyan took Ye Wuque back to the Central Imperial Territory, Ran Wei had followed him secretly.
Therefore, Ran Wei was not blind to what happened to Ye Wuque along the way, but he knew a little bit about it.
"Dad!"
"The Secret Realm of Mountains and Rivers Book!"
"Your Excellency Ye needs the Secret Realm Book of Mountains and Rivers. I originally promised Mr. Ye to come here because Uncle Qi had it, but this happened."
"Your Excellency Ye is very fond of special heaven and earth environments. He wants to find a heaven and earth environment that meets his needs. The kind of imbalance of yin and yang or collapse may be recorded in the mountain and river secret realm book. Have you brought it with you?"
Ran Shaoyan quickly told Ran Wei the situation.
"The Mountain and River Secret Realm Book? This...I didn't bring it with me! But Lao Qi does have it with him. He is the person in charge of the secret station."
"Damn it, Lao Qi was probably stopped by Aunt Qiu, so I have to go there myself!"
